name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Acrylic Car Seat Headrest Hook
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from premium 3mm clear acrylic with a smooth, glossy finish for vibrant and long-lasting printing.
    - Includes a durable car seat hook made of sturdy ABS plastic for reliable daily use.
    - Comes with a strong adhesive dot for easy attachment between the acrylic piece and the hook.
    - Features rounded edges for safe handling and a sleek appearance.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Acrylic Piece: 3 × 3 in ~ 7.62 × 7.62 cm.
    - Car Seat Hook: 2.52 × 3.34 in ~ 6.4 × 8.5 cm.
    - Hook Thickness: 3 mm.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses high-quality UV printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Features one-sided printing on the acrylic piece.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Keeps handbags, backpacks, grocery bags, umbrellas, shopping bags, water bottles, and other everyday essentials organized and within easy reach.
    - Helps prevent bags and belongings from rolling on the floor or spilling while driving.
    - Can be installed on either the front or rear side of the headrest for flexible use.
    - Suitable for most cars, SUVs, trucks, and vans with removable headrest posts.
    - Combines a practical car organizer with a personalized acrylic decoration to add a unique touch to your vehicle's interior.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful gift for car owners, pet lovers, family members, friends, couples, new drivers, and coworkers.
    - Perfect for Birthdays, Christmas, Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, Father's Day, Anniversaries, Graduations, Housewarmings, and New Car celebrations.
    - Great for anyone who enjoys personalized car accessories that are both decorative and practical.
    - An ideal keepsake for adding personality while keeping vehicles neat, organized, and clutter-free.

 

  • Installation Instructions:
    - Peel off the protective backing from the adhesive dot.
    - Attach the acrylic piece firmly to the front of the car seat hook.
    - Hang the hook onto the vehicle headrest rod.
    - Wait a few minutes before hanging heavier items to ensure the adhesive is fully secured.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x   Custom Shape 1-Layer Acrylic Car Seat Headrest Hook

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
